name: ILoveMyTools
tagline: Free browser-based tools incl. an AI content detector and AI background remover, plus PDF and image tools.
description: ILoveMyTools is a free website with more than 50 online tools. Its AI tools include an AI content detector for text and an AI background remover for photos. It also covers PDF work (edit existing text, merge, split, compress, sign, protect, convert, fill and create forms) and images (compress, resize and convert JPG, PNG, WebP and AVIF). File tools run in the browser, so documents stay on the user's device. No sign-up, no watermarks, available in 10 languages.
